notes.title: The Newest Playback Trauma Game is Coming Soon!!
notes.content:
Important Note: Purchase the Playback Trauma bundle for a 10% discount on the series!

The store page for the newest Playback Trauma game has been launched!  Instead of a beach or a highway, this time you'll be exploring a forest while looking for your lost dog Marla.  

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2878640/Playback_Trauma_The_Dog/utm_source=pttb_news

This very same forest has been the bane of New Jersey residents for years, as seen here:

[previewyoutube=fijdBdu4zwI;full][/previewyoutube]


Can you find Marla and escape the forest together safely?

- Jonathan

notes.title: Major Language Update!
notes.content:
For the last few months we've been working on a big update to bring this game to a larger audience due to some amazing people who took the time to help me.  Thanks to the translators who assisted with this:

French/Dutch - Pierre Van Der Heyde
German - Nat
Spanish - Tawny

Russian - Kateryfied

Danish - Stine
Norwegian - Stian
Swedish - Martin Haggstrom
Polish - Jacek Wącior
Finnish - Maria
Japanese - Sachiko Miura
Chinese - Horace Pan
Korean - Phimze
Czech - Halka B.
Hungarian - adri0310
Romanian - Miahela
Thai - Phimze
Ukrainian - Liz

Unfortunately after some technical difficulties with the company Apple I've had to drop support for Mac and similar products entirely.  That means this update and the game in itself will only be available for Windows systems.  In the event this changes in the future a similar update like this will be made and you will be notified.  I'm sorry for how inconvenient this is, but I hope to make up for this shortcoming in the future.

To all those who have been traumatized, thank you!  There's more to come

- Jonathan

notes.title: The Newest Playback Trauma is here!!
notes.content:
Important Note: Purchase the Playback Trauma Series bundle for a 10% discount on the series!

We've been hard at work for the last year to bring an even bigger part of the Playback Trauma universe to life.  If you've purchased 'PT: The Beach' I want to thank you from the bottom of my heart, and I'm honored that the game reached as many people as it did.
It's been an odd journey, and for better or worse there's no end in sight.


- Jonathan
